verify.what: local rebuild vs the headline score files (max abs differences)

_about: P3 out-of-support audit (p3_ood_audit.py), build def1027, headline tournament. WP points = 100 x fraction of win probability on the y - WP_pop scale. n bins = merged games on the hero before the as-of day: ['0', '1', '2-4', '5-19', '20+']. No player keys.

exposure.hot_thin_rule: 1 <= n <= 5 and (mean past y - WP_pop >= 0.2 or win share >= 0.8)

assignments.own: drafter's value model: best of 120 by b2 S + b3 O on the cur state (b2 = 4.243)
assignments.of: outcome-free: most earlier games (the judge-free record's rule and outcome-free J)
assignments.actual: the human who actually played the hero

exposure.opponents: each arm's drafts in both seats against the other arms of x-combo1-dr-chance, pMCTS-cur, aMCTS-pp, aMCTS-cur, a1step-cur, p1step-cur, DraftRec, DraftRec-pv, GD, Real

curse.window: realized: 2026-07-01 to 09-11 (judge window; slot rows, post-snapshot, not the sealed build, not a sealed id). Predictions made before it, so outcome-independent of every fitted piece.
curse.realized: game-weighted cell mean of y - WP_pop; slope of realized on predicted; gap = realized - predicted
curse.bins: n = merged games on the hero before the as-of day
curse.selection_caveat: Realized edges exist only for cells the player chose to play in the window. Players keep playing heroes that go well and drop ones that go badly, so the played subset of thin cells is selected on the player's own (unobserved) form; the share of selected cells with any window games is reported next to each block.

judges.definition: predicted personal term of one player-hero cell in WP points at p = 0.5: (c2 / 4) s_judge (J, gd, v2) and (cal_k c2 / 4) s_judge (J_cal); CONS has no personal term (predicts 0). Judge state: evidence 2026-07-01 to 09-11 only, as of 09-11.

windows.in_window: 2026-07-01 to 09-11, the window the judges are fit and scored on (in-sample: the judge's own evidence; the c2 fit uses the same games)
windows.later: 2026-09-28 to 10-26, patch 2.57 (weekly build wk261101 slot table, sealed replays excluded): out of sample for every judge, but a new patch 2.5 to 6.5 weeks after the judge state

bins.judge_n: games on the hero in the judge window (the judge's evidence)
bins.lifetime_n: merged games on the hero before 2026-07-01 (the drafter's n)

record.definition: judge-free paired record (p3t_analyze.paired_record): a player's judge-window mean y - WP_pop on the hero arm A put him on minus on the hero arm B put him on (heroes to players by most earlier games), players covered under both arms; per lobby the mean over covered players, then the mean over lobbies. Contribution of a bin = its share of that double mean (contributions add to the total). Bins: the n of A's cell (and of B's cell).
